name: Max OI Instrument
description: This keyword will return the instrument with the maximum open interest at that instant. You can input the underlying instrument, expiry and option type. Your request will be processed and a response will be fetched. At the moment it is only available for indices.
how_to_use_markdown:
This keyword will return the instrument with the maximum open interest at that instant. You can input the underlying instrument, expiry and option type. Your request will be processed and a response will be fetched. At the moment it is only available for indices.
